Around 40minutes away, there are outlying temple that mostly unvisited, most of them are hidden and forgotten. Our teams will share you the history of Gods and Demons of each Hidden temple. The Journey will ends in Prambanan Temple Complex. A 9th century temple, built by Sanjaya Dynasty.
Prambanan is a Hindu temple compound located in Central Java, Indonesia, near Yogyakarta. It is one of the largest temple complexes in Indonesia and is known for its impressive architecture and cultural significance. The temple complex is dedicated to the Trimurti, the three main Hindu deities: Brahma the creator, Vishnu the preserver, and Shiva the destroyer.

description:
Experience the unforgettable beauty of Borneo’s iconic orangutans in their natural habitat on this immersive one-day tour. Journey deep into Tanjung Puting National Park as you visit two renowned ranger stations and cruise along the scenic Sekonyer River by private speedboat. This trip is perfect for travelers seeking a short yet meaningful wildlife encounter.

Begin with a pickup from your hotel or Pangkalan Bun Airport. Depart by private speedboat along the Sekonyer River. Visit Pondok Tangguy Ranger Station to observe orangutans during feeding time.

Depart Pondok Tangguy and continue cruising along the lush Sekonyer River. Visit Tanjung Harapan Ranger Station for another opportunity to see orangutans up close. Cruise back to Pangkalan Bun, Kumai, or the airport.

description:
Begin your adventure with a convenient pick-up from your accommodation in Yogyakarta.
Your journey starts at Prambanan Temple, the largest and most intricate Hindu temple complex in Indonesia. Built between the 8th and 10th centuries, this magnificent masterpiece represents the harmony between Hindu and Buddhist philosophies. It honors the Trimurti—Brahma, Vishnu, and Shiva—and stands proudly as the tallest Hindu temple in the country, a true crown jewel of Southeast Asia.

After exploring Prambanan, take a relaxing lunch break at a local restaurant, where you can enjoy authentic Javanese cuisine before continuing your journey (optional)

Next, head to the awe-inspiring Borobudur Temple, the world’s grandest Buddhist monument. Adorned with 504 Buddha statues and thousands of intricate stone carvings, this massive structure reveals the serene beauty of the seated Buddha surrounded by countless stupas.

As daylight fades, sit back and relax while your private driver transfers you comfortably back to your hotel in Yogyakarta—ending your unforgettable cultural journey.
highlights:
• Enjoy full access to every temple and the opportunity to climb to the top.
  • Explore the iconic UNESCO World Heritage Temples of Borobudur and Prambanan.

description:
Day 1: Arrival – Tanjung Puting National Park – Overnight on Klotok

Begin your adventure with a pickup from Pangkalan Bun Airport. Transfer by car to Kumai Port and board the klotok river boat. Begin your cruise into Tanjung Puting National Park. Enjoy lunch and dinner served onboard. Sleep on the boat in a cozy cabin with mosquito netting.

Day 2: Village Visit – Palm Oil Insight – Camp Leakey – Jungle Cruise

After breakfast onboard, visit Sekonyer Village to experience local life. Learn about the impact of the palm oil industry on the environment. Return to the boat for lunch. In the afternoon, visit Camp Leakey to observe orangutans in the wild. Return to the boat for leisure time and dinner. Spend the night onboard amidst the sounds of the jungle.

Day 3: Pondok Tanggui – Wildlife Observation – Return to Airport

Enjoy breakfast on the boat before visiting Pondok Tanggui for orangutan feeding observation. Cruise back while enjoying the rich flora and fauna along the river. Arrive at Kumai Port and transfer to Pangkalan Bun Airport.

Begin your adventure with a pickup from your hotel in Banyuwangi. Head to De Djawatan Forest, a magical grove of giant Trembesi trees. With its fairytale-like atmosphere often compared to The Lord of the Rings, this forest offers a unique and photogenic experience.

Next, depart for Alas Purwo National Park, one of Java’s oldest and most sacred nature reserves. Along the way, enjoy scenic views of local farmlands — orange groves, dragon fruit plantations, rice fields, and peanut farms.

Arrive at Alas Purwo National Park and begin your exploration with your local guide. Discover several fascinating sites including teak and mahogany forests, the ancient Hindu Kawitan Site, and Bekol Savanna, home to Javan banteng (Bos javanicus), green peacocks, deer, and other herbivores roaming freely in the wild.

After exploring, enjoy a coffee break at Pancur Beach, where you can relax with a fresh young coconut, coffee, or tea. Continue the journey to G-Land Beach (Plengkung Beach) using a local jeep, passing through diverse tropical vegetation and rare plant species.

Arrive at G-Land, one of the world’s most famous surf beaches. Enjoy a peaceful walk along the shoreline while watching the stunning sunset over the Indian Ocean. Return to Pancur Beach by jeep, then transfer to your main vehicle and head back to Banyuwangi city.
highlights:
• Immerse yourself in the mystical beauty of De Djawatan Forest
  • Explore Alas Purwo National Park, one of Java’s oldest nature reserves
  • Discover the Bekol Savanna, home to Javan banteng and green peacocks
  • Relax at Pancur Beach with a fresh coconut, coffee, or tea
  • Visit G-Land Beach, a world-famous surf spot, and enjoy a sunset walk

description:
A trip from Yogyakarta to Bromo and ljen typically involves a scenic journey through
Java's diverse landscapes. You'll start by traveling east to Bromo, where the iconic Mount Bromo and its mesmerizing sunrise await. After exploring Bromo, the journey continues to ljen, known for its stunning blue fire phenomenon (subject to change deppend on weather condition) and acidic crater lake. Along the way, you'll encounter picturesque villages and lush greenery.


Day 1
08:00 meet our representative at your Hotel and depart from Yogyakarta. The journey will take approximately 7 hours driving with highway. You may ask our representative to stop for lunch in the middle of journey. Once you arrived at your accomodation, you will have free time to relax and enjoy. Have enough rest and be prepare for the next day activities start at 03:00.

Day 2
03:00 Picked up by 4x4 Jeep driver for Bromo Sunrise Point, enjoy the enchanting the golden sunrise with amazing lanscape of Mt Bromo, Mt Batok, and Mt Semeru. Then proceed to Bromo Crater by the Jeep. After that Walk a long the sea of sand to enjoy The Bromo Caldera from the rim. Afterwards, back to your accommodation for breakfast and check out from the accommodation at 10:00. Continue your journey to the accomodation near Ijen Crater. It will take approximately 4 hours driving.


Day 3
Check out from the accommodation (take away breakfast) and drive to Ijen meeting point, it will take approximately 1.5 hours driving. At 02:00 start trekking with local guide to Summit of Ijen Crater, Total trekking activities at Ijen crater will take approximately 4-5 hours. Witness mesmerising blue flame and sunrise (only on your lucky day), also listening the guide telling you about the Mining activity from the locals. Depart from Ijen at 07:30 and drive 1.5 hours driving to Ketapang Harbour (drop-off point) cross the ferry then drop off to your hotel in bali.

description:
Experience the enchanting beauty of The Authentic Sunset of Baluran National Park on our comprehensive guided tour, where natural splendor unfolds before your eyes.
Your journey begins as you explore the park's diverse habitats. Explore the vast savanna, where you can see Javanese deer, Javan buffalo, majestic peacocks roaming majestically amidst the golden grasslands. Have your camera ready as you explore the lush mangrove forest, a sanctuary for a variety of bird species and home to the elusive Javan langur monkey, known for its striking black and white plumage.
Our knowledgeable guides will accompany you, sharing captivating insights into the park's rich biodiversity and the amazing behavior of its inhabitants. Learn about the conservation efforts being made to protect these unique animals and the balance of the ecosystem within the park.

As the sun begins to set, find the best spot to watch the stunning sunset that is characteristic of Baluran. The sky turns into a canvas of bright colors, casting magical light over the calm lake and reflecting the silhouettes of the surrounding trees and wildlife.

Throughout the tour, our guide will tell stories and facts about the history of the national park, the importance of preserving its natural beauty, and ongoing efforts to protect the diverse animals that live in Baluran.
Whether you are a wildlife enthusiast, nature lover, or someone looking for a peaceful retreat, The Authentic Sunset of Baluran National Park offers the experience of witnessing a harmonious blend of nature, wildlife and stunning sunset views in this East Java treasure.

description:
Mount Ijen Blue Fire & Sunrise Tour – One Day Adventure

Meet Haqim (QimQim), your enthusiastic local guide
Conquering Mount Ijen isn’t about how fast or strong your guide is—it’s about being enthusiastic, engaging, punctual, and prepared for any situation. Born in a nearby village, Haqim brings deep passion and insider knowledge to every Blue Fire trip.

Tour Overview:
Embark on a thrilling one-day journey from Banyuwangi to witness the mesmerizing Blue Fire of Mount Ijen and enjoy panoramic views of the crater lake. Start early, trek through lush landscapes, marvel at the surreal blue flames, and watch a stunning sunrise from the summit—an unforgettable adventure awaits!

Tour Itinerary

23:00 – 23:30
Pick-up from your hotel in Banyuwangi and depart for Ijen Volcano by shared car.

01:30
Arrive at Ijen parking area. Briefing session and time to relax before the hike.

02:00
Begin your hike to Ijen Volcano.

03:00
Reach the summit and, if conditions allow, descend to the crater.

⚠ Important Notice:
After the recent earthquake, the crater area is unstable. Descent is allowed only if the sulfur fumes are safe and participants are physically fit for a 900-meter steep descent. Participants should not have fear of heights, asthma, or heart conditions.

Crater Activities:

Monitor volcanic activity at one of the world’s most active volcanoes.

Observe traditional sulfur miners at work.

Witness the rare Blue Fire (visibility depends on conditions; miners sometimes extinguish flames to preserve sulfur productivity).

04:00 – 04:30
Climb to the sunrise viewpoint.

05:00 – 06:00
Coffee break at the viewpoint. Relax, enjoy hot coffee or tea, and marvel at the breathtaking sunrise and panoramic crater views (2,386 meters above sea level). Free time for photos and guide explanations about Ijen Volcano history.

06:00
Descend back to the parking area.

07:30 – 08:00
Depart for Banyuwangi.

09:00
Arrive back at your hotel.

BALI DEPARTURE :
Our driver will pick you up from your hotel in Bali .Drive to Gilimanuk(Bali) port then cross with ferry by your self.Upon you arrived in Ketapang port(Java) our driver and guide will meet you then heading to Paltuding(Starting hiking point).

Brifing before hiking then continue to hiking to see blue fire(not guaranteed depending of weather) and enjoy the view of lake with sunrise.

Back to starting point and prepare for return to Bali island.
highlights:
• Experience the mesmerizing Blue Fire phenomenon at Ijen Crater
  • Marvel at the turquoise crater lake glowing under the morning sun
  • Experience a breathtaking sunrise from Kawah Ijen’s peak.
  • Discover the unique sulfur mining tradition amid majestic scenery.
  • Marvel at the glowing natural wonder against the dark sky.
